tierPolicy: Catalog presence is not verification. Only provider-specific real upstream lifecycle evidence can promote a connector to verified; blocked providers remain beta or catalog-only.
enablementPolicy: No provider is automatically enabled solely because it was merged. Default enablement is explicit and evidence-referenced in src/control-plane/index.ts.
securityPolicy: Agent receives only connection refs, leases, and redacted bounded schemas/results; tokens, cookies, AK/SK, signed URLs, and plaintext credentials remain server-side.
externalBlockers: See evidence manifest; blockers are external accounts, credentials, tenants, entitlements, private-network/TLS targets, or bounded-read targets, not known uncompleted implementation work.
rollback: Redeploy base SHA 3bbd44624933300487a54ee3acba23190b66ee98 or remove this candidate deployment; preserve backups and do not reuse expansion credentials.
finalShaMeaning: Current pushed branch tip; this commit contains the final per-worker lease validation evidence metadata.
